artboards.title: Trash view · Restore / Delete permanently / Empty
Share sheet · plugins and nearby devices

annotations.text:
kiki · file manager for Omarchy
Rust backend + Quickshell (QML) front end. Tokyo Night palette, Cascadia Mono, 2px Hyprland-style active border, no title bar.
Row 1: the three views plus split mode. Row 2: Locations + dialog (generated from each location plugin's form; SFTP and FTPS ship first), the xdg-desktop-portal Open dialog kiki provides to other apps, and the inspector's Permissions tab. Row 3: mirror.

Columns: each folder click pushes a column; a file click replaces the next column with the tabbed inspector (General / Permissions). Ancestor selections dim to grey, the active one is blue. Deeper paths scroll the column strip horizontally; the inspector keeps a 300px minimum.

Every destructive op (trash, move, rename, extract, chmod) is journaled so Ctrl+Z undoes it. The toast is the visible half of the undo stack.
The inspector panel is toggled from the toolbar (info button) in icon and list views; in columns view it is always the last column.

Split: selecting a remote location opens it side by side. The left pane goes to the location's local path, the right to its remote path. Drag or Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V between panes transfers; transfers show in the status bar and are undoable. The split toggle in the toolbar turns it off (remote alone).

Mirror (row 3): the mirror button in the split-mode toolbar replaces the two panes with this workspace. Configure builds the spec; Preflight scans (same frame, progress bar in place of the form); Review is the mandatory preview with per-row opt-out; Running shows each action's status with N in flight (3 by default). Done is the Running table plus a summary line. Not undoable by design; see docs/0.1.0/08-mirror.md.

Search: `/` focuses the box. Scope lives in the field two ways: type a prefix (`everywhere:` or a location name with a colon, which becomes a chip), or open the scope menu from the chevron / chip. Plain text searches this folder, filtering the open listing in place. Everywhere replaces the pane with ranked two-line results: match highlighted, parent folder under it. Backspace on an empty query removes the chip; Tab cycles scopes. Enter opens; Ctrl+Enter reveals in folder; Esc returns to the folder you were in. See docs/0.1.0/12-search.md.

Project mode (row 4): `e` on a folder. kiki collapses to a 320px project tree (header with project name, branch chip, Leave; filter; tree with git badges; shortcut bar). Hyprland tiles the editor entry (here Neovim, focused, blue border) and the agent entry (here Claude Code) to its right; kiki drives the arrangement, nothing is embedded. Clicking a file in the tree switches the editor buffer; Alt+Enter sends the selection to the agent. Esc leaves project mode and the other two keep running. See docs/0.1.0/16-project-mode.md.

Row 5: the Trash view (trash:// listing with the original location, Restore on Enter, Delete permanently on Del, Empty Trash), the Share sheet (plan 18: share plugins on the left, LocalSend's nearby devices with manual entry, compose fields from the plugin), the Jarvis panel (plan 19: chat about the selected files; local answers for counts, otherwise the AI Omarchy selected, run as its CLI) and the Settings window (plan 20: one page per area, writes through immediately).
